pages.name: Benko Gambit Accepted: King Walk Variation
pages.notes: Overview said walking the king to g2 sidesteps the queenside pressure; it is about safety after losing castling. Plan 1 played ...Rfb8 with the queen on d8; plan 2 suggested Be2 after the light-squared bishops were traded. Rewrote; British spelling in plans 3-4.

pages.name: Benko Gambit Accepted: Yugoslav
pages.notes: Overview had 7.e4 challenging the a6-bishop; plan 1 exchanged it via Bxf7+ or Be3-Bh6 (impossible); plan 3 suggested castling after Kxf1. Rewrote overview and all four plans around ...Bxf1 Kxf1 and the king walk.

pages.name: Benko Gambit: 7.e4 Line, 9.Nf3
pages.notes: Overview and plans 1 and 3 gave White the bishop pair and a g2-bishop after the light-squared bishops were traded; plan 2 played ...Ra8 with the rook already there. Rewrote overview and plans 1-3 (g3 and Kg2, or h3, Kg1 and Kh2).

pages.name: Benko Gambit: 7.e4, Main Line
pages.notes: Plan 2 returned the pawn with a3 and spoke of a passed d-pawn; plan 4 named c4 and d4 targets read as moves; plan 3 was vague about the king. Rewrote plans 2-4; British spelling in plan 1.

pages.name: Benko Gambit: 7.e4, Main Line, 11...Nbd7 12.h3 Qb6
pages.notes: Plan 1 rerouted the d7-knight via b8-c6 or f8-e6 (nonsense); plan 4 said ...e6 opens lines for the g7-bishop. Rewrote plans 1, 2 and 4; British spelling in the overview and plan 3.

pages.name: Benoni: 4.Nc3 exd5 5.cxd5 d6
pages.notes: Plan 3 used a g7-bishop not yet developed; plan 4 named Nd2-b3 with no knight on d2. Rewrote plans 3-4; British spelling in the overview and plan 1.

pages.name: Benoni: 4.Nc3 exd5 5.Nxd5
pages.notes: Plan 1 targeted a d6-pawn Black has not played; plan 2 read Qxd5 as a Black move. Rewrote both plans around ...Nxd5 and the two recaptures; British spelling in the overview.

pages.name: Benoni: 4.Nf3 exd5 5.cxd5
pages.notes: Plan 2 called Black's queenside majority a minority attack; plan 4 made d6 a knight outpost for Black. Rewrote plans 2-4; British spelling in the overview and plan 1.

pages.name: Benoni: Snake Variation vs. 4.Nf3
pages.notes: Plan 1 fianchettoed a bishop that is already on d6 and wrote castling as 0-0. Rewrote plan 1; British spelling in plan 2.

pages.name: Benoni: Snake, 6.Nf3
pages.notes: Plan 1 read control of e5 as a move; reworded. British spelling in plan 2.
